conventions: cells lists every non-empty coordinate in row-major order: "at" is [x, y], then what is there plus a one-line description. This section alone fully describes the screen.
kind tile: art tile stamped at the cell.
kind static: fixed ASCII letter from the intrepid tileset (see fonts).
kind variable: dynamic digit cell; field names the value, place the digit (tens/ones/...). Values are right-aligned: the ones digit cell is fixed, the field grows left.
Two-row glyphs split into top/bottom halves; single-row glyphs use part "single".

Scenery tiles are positional slots (starting-point-*/destination-*, rows top/middle/bottom). The biome providing the art is resolved per journey route (origin_biome/destination_biome -> assets/travels/<biome>.png); mockup shows forest origin + snow destination.

Scenery tiles are named side-row-zone (starting-point-*/destination-*, rows top/middle/bottom, zones left/middle/right plus stem/accent/far/sky/edge/base/ground/speckles details). Origin = route start, destination = route end; wiring picks the biome tileset per side (see scenery).

Scenery tiles are named side-row-zone (starting-point-*/destination-*, rows top/middle/bottom, zones left/middle/right plus stem/accent/far/sky/edge/base/ground/speckles details). Origin = route start, destination = route end; wiring picks the biome tileset per side (see scenery).
Names follow the assets/*.csv style: lowercase words with spaces.
The mockup is a loose artist render, not pixel-exact: names describe INTENT per cell, the artist snaps art to the 8px grid when drawing.

fonts.intrepid: ASCII tileset assets/intrepid.png (16x6 sheet, chars 32-127), 1 tile per cell. Renders the 1-row TRAVELING... title. The artist may restyle glyphs; the wiring stays ASCII codes.
fonts.intrepid large: Double-height ASCII for SUPPLIES/stats (each glyph 2 cells tall). Not in intrepid.png yet: the artist extends the sheet with top/bottom halves per glyph (mockup shows tall narrow serif caps, digits and colon).

scenery.rule: Rows 2-4 form the journey strip. Cols 1-10 stamp the ORIGIN biome grove kit; cols 11-18 stamp the DESTINATION biome vista kit. Each journey route declares origin_biome/destination_biome (e.g. forest->desolate); tools/screen_compiler/travel_art_compile.py fetches assets/travels/<biome>.png for each side and emits planar tile data + a per-route strip table (src/game/travel_art_content.c). Horse, progress bar/flag and all UI are journey chrome overlaid on top, not scenery.

forest.note: Mockup pair shows the forest grove (green trees, dirt trail).

village.note: Orchard grove + rooftop vista to be drawn (see town tileset).

desolate.note: Dead scrub grove + boulder vista to be drawn (see desolate tileset).

snow.note: No current route ends in snow; mockup pair shows the snow vista. Sheet to be drawn when a snowy destination exists.

sheet.size: 64x24 px = 8 columns x 3 rows of 8px tiles
sheet.order: row-major: grove kit slots (cells 0-9) then vista kit slots (cells 10-23), in scenery grove_slots/vista_slots order
sheet.palette: Transparent background; at most 4 shades per tile (Game Boy 2bpp, enforced by the compiler).

palette.progress black: #000000 bar; dots white, upcoming dim gray
